scope: Finite IIO reader progress and cancellation prerequisites, not a paired recorder, live DMA/RF qualification or300second scanner.

features.queue_full_policy: fail capture; never wait for capacity or silently drop
features.cancellation: external Event is never cleared; checks before capture I/O, each budget, after final copy/hash and before terminal decision
features.terminal_authority: capture return or retained exception, not event delivery
features.optional_origin_snapshot: at most one after first refill when ARM has no delivered prefix
features.snapshot_generation: ARM establishes a new post-CLEAR epoch; subsequent generation wrap/reset/staleness fails closed

review.caught_and_fixed: pilot_preenable resets generation to0; do not require ARM generation greater than previous pre-buffer epoch

limitations: Provisional events and cached context identity do not prove continuously authenticated boot/RF identity.
Enqueued bytes are not consumer-received or durably persisted bytes; reconcile final outcomes and disk receipts independently.
Queue count bounds caller-controlled event storage; final in-memory IQ/native buffers/copies consume additional memory.
Snapshot/raw batch error retention, concurrent paired coordinator, source-support coverage and explicit map-stop/drain contracts remain required.
Full same-source blind GLRT/FPGA timing lock, .18-before-.17 deployment, eight120ms visits over300s/>=95% duty and15/30/60MS/s remain open.
